scope: Third E106 trial: root cause identified as PPLC forward label-reference capacity

console_report.v192: E106 at line 3247 (goto v19_skip_te2); inherited W008 at 2951

diagnosis: In all six failing console compiles (two methods x three trials) E106 was raised at exactly the 147th forward goto of the preprocessed stream. String, token, if, conversion and pending-reference counts all differ between those sites. v18 compiles with 145 forward gotos. PPLC keeps a far-scratch record for each goto whose label is not yet defined; v19 added error-guard jumps to the shared end label and exhausted it.
fix: end and v19_fail now label a hub immediately after the first statement (v19_error_code=0). Every later jump to them, including goto end expanded from vendor macros (CREATE_MATRIX, BASEMATRIX, MR3040_DEGLITCH) and tstex_15.pph, is a backward reference. The hub forwards once to v19_exit, the unchanged shared exit at the old end position. No other source line changed.
